description: This file declares the SNMPClientReqHandler class, which provides an interface for handling SNMP client requests within the host interface module. It includes method declarations for initialization, message handling, callback registration, and management of the request handler instance.

classes.name: SNMPClientReqHandler
classes.description: A singleton class that manages SNMP client request handling, providing interfaces for initialization, message processing, attribute management, and update callbacks.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the SNMP client request handler.

methods.name: unInit
methods.description: Uninitializes the SNMP client request handler, freeing resources.

methods.name: handleSetMsg
methods.description: Processes SNMP set requests received from the host.

methods.name: handleGetMsg
methods.description: Processes SNMP get requests received from the host.

methods.name: handleGetAttributesMsg
methods.description: Handles requests to retrieve attributes related to SNMP client requests.

methods.name: handleSetAttributesMsg
methods.description: Handles requests to set attributes related to SNMP client requests.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the SNMPClientReqHandler.

methods.name: registerUpdateCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback function to be invoked on updates.

methods.name: checkForUpdates
methods.description: Checks if there are any updates to process.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the SNMP client request handler to its initial state.
